decision.explanation: The query 'When was Carl Roth born?' targets the birth dates of individuals named 'Carl Roth'. The provided documents describe four distinct entities with this name (or close variation): 1) Carl Reinhold Roth (Documents 1 & 2), which contain conflicting birth dates (Nov 18, 1797 vs Jan 1, 1800); 2) Carl Roth II (Document 3), born Oct 12, 1753; and 3) Carl William Roth (Document 4), born Sept 15, 1909. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers, all four dates are included as they correspond to different individuals or conflicting claims regarding the same individual that cannot be resolved without external verification. The entity 'Charles II' in Document 5 is irrelevant.
